newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: New Tobago council opened.
newsitem.headline: New Tobago council opened.

text.p: A new era in the evolution of this Caribbean holiday island to internal self- government was ushered in on Wednesday when the Tobago House of Assembly was inaugurated.
President Noor Hassanali of the twin island state of Trindiad and Tobago swore in members of the new 12-seat house following Monday's elections.

Hochoy Charles, one of ten successful candidates of the National Alliance for Reconstuction (NAR) party, was elected Chief Secretary, a new post replacing the chairman created under new constitutional arrangements granting the 116-square mile (300 sq km) sister island of Trinidad greater autonomy.
Linked together by Britain since 1889, both islands form the unitary state of Trinidad and Tobago.

However, there has been a strong clamour by the 50,000 inhabitants of Tobago for greater autonomy from the central government in Port of Spain, the Trinidad capital. They claimed the island was neglected by successive governments over the past 40 years.
Granting of greater power to the council was aimed at satisfying the aspirations of the people of Tobago, a government spokesman said.
